scientific_interpretation.purpose: Evaluate fresh SAC training with polarization-aware observations under a polarization-aware PHY.
scientific_interpretation.observation_space: 140D: 20 users × [SINR, interference, queue, power, trust, PQI, XPI].
scientific_interpretation.interpretation_limit: This experiment evaluates polarization-aware observation, not direct polarization control or joint RIS/polarization optimization.
scientific_interpretation.controlled_evaluation: Six independent seeds using the restored best SAC checkpoint.
